criterion.text: 给定这个角色此刻知道的信息，他最可能立刻做的一件事是什么。以他的目标为主要依据；现场没有条件做目标里那一步时，写他为了创造条件而做的下一步（例如移动到目的地、去找人）。

labels.order: groups in file order, predicates in file order

backbone.name: MiniRBT-H256
backbone.dirArgument: --base (resolved on the HPC login node; not present on this machine)
backbone.expectedWeightsNote: records the weights file the previous component line trained against; train.py reports the actual sha it loaded
backbone.tokenizer: BertTokenizer from the same directory; the tokenizer files are hashed into the run report

seed.rule: torch.manual_seed + random.seed + numpy seed (when numpy is imported) happen BEFORE the encoder is loaded and BEFORE any new head parameter exists
seed.why: the reference trainer seeded after model construction; that ordering is not reused

arms.selection: validation only; the test set is opened once, after the arm and hyperparameters are fixed
arms.reporting: the two arms are reported separately; they are never averaged

hyper.earlyStop: validation primaryGroupHit, patience 3 epochs, best checkpoint kept
hyper.maxLenRule: measure_tokens.py reports the 100th percentile over train+validation; maxLen = that value rounded UP to a multiple of 32, capped at 384; if the 100th percentile exceeds 384 the run stops and reports the count instead of truncating

loss.action: CrossEntropyLoss(weight=fineWeights) per step slot, masked where the row has no such step
loss.object: CrossEntropyLoss over [null, candidate_1..candidate_n], masked where the row has no such step; padding scores are masked by the candidate mask
loss.fineWeightRule: weight_i = clip(median(count)/count_i, 1.0, 1.5); computed from the TRAIN split only and printed in the run report
loss.note: skip stays a real learnable class; skip rows contribute no action/object loss and one-step rows contribute no slot-2 loss

data.trainSource: 13-action-dataset; 01 reviewed every row; 03 blind second review of 10%
data.validationSource: separate rows, isolated by goal family (see dataset.check_split_isolation)
data.testSource: 01-frozen, 15 withheld goals, opened exactly once after the arm and hyperparameters are fixed
data.noSyntheticTrainingRows: synthetic fixtures exist only under tests/ and are labelled fixture

metrics.primaryGroupHit: coarse group of step 1 vs the frozen acceptable group set
metrics.fullHit: exact steps list: count, order, fine predicate, object
metrics.skipRecall: skips predicted / skips in the frozen answer
metrics.wrongActionRate: non-skip rows whose step-1 group is not acceptable
metrics.perGoal: one row per withheld goal with its scenario count

notClaimed: a 12-group hit is not a full Y
one 300-row version is not proof that the task is unlearnable
an experimental classifier is not a product protocol change
